name: Investigator / Martyr
life_theme: Build a solid foundation of knowledge, then learn through experimentation and 'failure'.
work_pattern: Need to thoroughly research before feeling confident. Trial-and-error is the natural learning mode — every 'mistake' builds real expertise. The martyr line means setbacks are part of the path, not signals to stop.
career_approach: Build deep foundational knowledge first. Then experiment practically. Don't stay in roles or relationships that aren't working — the 3 line learns by discovering what doesn't work. Multiple career phases are normal.
growth_edge: Releasing self-blame for 'failures' — they are the data, not the verdict.
